ch.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: 我需要感染爆发区域的最新情报。去那里侦察一下情况，想办法活着回来。
ch.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: 我对你很失望，年轻人。眼下这些情报尤为重要。
ch.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 successMessageT: 总算是又少了一桩麻烦事儿，倒也不错。

ch.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: 我还以为你会迫不及待地想去收拾那些老大呢。行吧，随你。

ch.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: 这么说，你是不打算帮我手下的弟兄们了？行，他们会记住这笔账的。
ch.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: 行吧，至少他们现在有了家伙，能朝着街上的死鬼开火了。也算是个好的开始。
ch.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: 这他妈一天比一天乱！现在想搞到枪可不像以前那么容易了，人人都怕自己也染上那该死的病毒。没了枪，你让老子手下的弟兄们怎么办？难不成让他们飞起一脚，把那些丧尸活活踹死？去给我弄些武器回来，至于会操弄家伙什的人由我来找。
ch.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: 怎么，找到别的买卖了是吧？哼，我就知道。
ch.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: 这才像话嘛！希望我手下的那帮人能像点样子，别再和苍蝇一样莫名其妙就死一地了。
ch.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: 这年头，没了 Therapist 的疫苗，干啥都他妈寸步难行。你小子嘴皮子挺利索，去找她好好谈谈，能弄到多少就给我带多少回来。我会把疫苗分给手下的弟兄们。
ch.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: 我还以为咱们都是一条船上的人呢。看来是我想多了，是吧？
ch.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be successMessageT: 这些应该够我们撑上一阵子了。
ch.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: 为了研究病毒，我需要更多组织样本，越多越好。出发去感染区，尽可能多地消灭那些感染者。收集样本的事情就交给我的人吧，他们随后就到。
ch.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be changeQuestMess: 我明白了。看来我得重新安排人手了。
ch.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: 帮我从首批感染者的身上收集更多血样来，我的研究需要更多样本。记住，不能徒手去办，必须要用医疗工具才能采集到合格的样本。
ch.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: 我本来还指望着你呢。看来这活儿只能另找别人来干了。
ch.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 successMessageT: 很好。我会立刻安排人处理这些样本。
ch.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: 我又需要一些新鲜的感染者组织样本了。你之前和其他 PMC 交涉得非常出色，所以这次我还是想拜托你。样本送来的速度越快，对我的研究就越有帮助。
ch.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: 真遗憾。看来我只能另想办法获取这些样本了。

ge.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f successMessageT: Braver Junge. Hier ist dein Anteil.
ge.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f description 583: Alles klar, Kumpel? Meine Jungs brauchen ein paar Vorräte, ich hab hier eine Liste. Bring mit, was du so auftreiben kannst – das meiste davon ist heutzutage nützlich.
ge.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: Das ist schon ein bisschen enttäuschend. Macht nichts, ich finde schon jemand anderen.
ge.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 successMessageT: Das nenne ich mal eine ordentliche Entrümpelungsaktion!
ge.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: Wir können im Moment jede Hilfe gebrauchen, die wir kriegen können. Schnapp dir eine Waffe, zieh dich schick an und räum alles auf, was verdächtig aussieht. Diese Typen sind in letzter Zeit viel zu lebhaft geworden und kotzen an jeder Straßenecke ihre Lunge aus.
ge.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 changeQuestMess: Was, hast du schon keine Lust mehr? Wirst du etwa ein bisschen faul?
ge.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f successMessageT: Ausgezeichnet. Wir verfügen nun über aktuelle Informationen.
ge.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: Ich brauche aktuelle Informationen aus dem Ausbruchsgebiet. Begib dich dorthin, verschaffe dir einen Überblick über die Lage und kehre lebend zurück.
ge.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: Ich bin enttäuscht. Diese Informationen sind gerade jetzt besonders wichtig.
ge.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 successMessageT: Ein Problem weniger. Da kann man sich nicht beschweren.
ge.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: Das glaubst du nie. Einer der großen Fische der örtlichen Bande hat sich diese verdammte Infektion eingefangen. Der muss weg, bevor er die anderen ansteckt.
ge.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: Ich dachte mir schon, dass du die Gelegenheit, es mit den Bossen aufzunehmen, sofort ergreifen würdest. Na gut.
ge.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: Wunderbar. Vielleicht hören sie jetzt endlich auf, überall Blut zu vergießen.
ge.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: Diese infizierten Mistkerle sind echt eine echte Nervensäge! Meine Jungs haben bereits den Vorrat an medizinischem Material für einen ganzen Monat aufgebraucht. Wir müssen Nachschub besorgen, sonst haben wir keine Chance, diese Bande unter Kontrolle zu halten.
ge.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: Du würdest meinen Jungs also nicht helfen? Das werden sie sich merken.
ge.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: Na ja, zumindest haben sie jetzt etwas, womit sie schießen können. Das ist schon mal ein Anfang.
ge.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: Jeder Tag ist ein neues blutiges Chaos! Waffen zu beschaffen ist nicht mehr so einfach wie früher. Alle haben Angst, sich selbst anzustecken. Was sollen meine Jungs denn ohne Waffen machen – die Zombies mit Tritten zu Tode prügeln? Besorg mir ein paar Waffen, und ich sorge dafür, dass sie bei den richtigen Leuten landen.
ge.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: Du hast schon wieder ein Schnäppchen ergattert, oder? Ja, das habe ich mir schon gedacht.
ge.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: Das ist doch mal was. Hoffentlich fallen meine Jungs nicht mehr wie die Fliegen um.
ge.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: Ohne den Impfstoff von Therapist geht heutzutage kaum noch etwas. Du kannst Leute gut überzeugen, also sprich mal mit ihr. Bring so viel mit, wie du an die Hand bekommst. Ich werde das dann mit meinen Jungs regeln.
ge.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: Ich dachte, wir wären hier alle auf derselben Seite. Anscheinend nicht, oder?
ge.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be successMessageT: Das sollte für eine Weile reichen.
ge.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: An Forschungsmaterial kann es nie genug geben. Begib dich in die roten Zonen und eliminiere so viele Infizierte wie möglich. Meine Leute werden deinen Spuren folgen und Gewebeproben entnehmen.
ge.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be changeQuestMess: Verstehe. Dann muss ich meine Mitarbeiter neu einteilen.
ge.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: Entnehme den Leichen der ersten Opfer des Virus Blutproben für weitere Untersuchungen. Denk daran, dass dies nur mit medizinischen Instrumenten möglich ist.
ge.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: Ich hatte auf dich gezählt. Jetzt muss ich jemand anderen für den Job finden.
ge.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 successMessageT: Gut. Ich werde sie sofort bearbeiten lassen.
ge.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: Ich benötige erneut frische Gewebeproben von den Infizierten. Du hast bei den Verhandlungen mit anderen PMCs hervorragende Arbeit geleistet, daher wende ich mich an dich. Je früher du sie mir lieferst, desto nützlicher sind sie für meine Forschung.
ge.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: Schade. Ich muss mir wohl eine andere Möglichkeit suchen, an die Proben zu kommen.

hu.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: Bit of a letdown, that. Never mind, I'll find someone else.
hu.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: Could do with all the help we can get right now. Grab a gun, get yourself dressed up nice, and go sort out anything that looks dodgy. These things have been getting far too lively, coughing their guts up on every street corner.
hu.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 changeQuestMess: What, can't be bothered anymore? Getting a bit lazy, are we?

hu.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: I need fresh information from the outbreak zone. Get there, assess the situation, and make it back alive.
hu.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: I am disappointed. This information is particularly important right now.
hu.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 successMessageT: One less headache. Can't complain about that.
hu.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: You'll never guess what. One of the local gang's big shots has gone and caught that bloody infection. Need him put down before he passes it on to the rest.
hu.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: Thought you'd jump at the chance to have a go at the bosses. Fine.
hu.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: Lovely. Maybe now they'll stop bleeding all over the place.
hu.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: These infected cunts are a right pain in the arse! My lads have gone through a month's worth of medical supplies already. Need to get more in, or we won't stand a chance of keeping this lot under control.
hu.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: So you wouldn't help my lads, then? They'll remember that.
hu.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: Well, at least they've got something to shoot with now. That's a start.
hu.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: Every day's another bloody mess! Getting guns in ain't as easy as it used to be. Everyone's worried they'll catch the infection themselves. hu.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: Found yourself another deal, have you? Yeah, thought as much.
hu.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: Now that's the stuff. Hopefully my lads won't be dropping like flies anymore.
hu.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: Can't do much without Therapist's vaccine these days. You're good at talking people round, so go have a word with her. Bring back as much as you can get your hands on. I'll sort my lads out with it.
hu.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: Thought we were all on the same side here. Guess not, eh?

it.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f successMessageT: Bravo ragazzo. Ecco la tua parte.
it.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f description 583: Tutto bene amico? I miei ragazzi hanno bisogno di alcune provviste, ho una lista qui. Portate con voi tutto ciò che riuscite a trovare, è davvero utile al giorno d'oggi.
it.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: Un po' deludente, quello. Non preoccuparti, troverò qualcun altro.
it.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 successMessageT: Questa sì che è una vera e propria pulizia!
it.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: Ci farebbe comodo tutto l'aiuto possibile in questo momento. Prendi una pistola, vestiti bene e vai a sistemare tutto ciò che sembra losco. Queste cose sono diventate fin troppo vivaci, tossendo le budella ad ogni angolo di strada.
it.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 changeQuestMess: Cosa, non ne hai più voglia? Stiamo diventando un po' pigri, vero?
it.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f successMessageT: Eccellente. Ora disponiamo di informazioni aggiornate.
it.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: Ho bisogno di nuove informazioni dalla zona dell'epidemia. Arriva lì, valuta la situazione e torna vivo.
it.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: Sono deluso. Queste informazioni sono particolarmente importanti in questo momento.
it.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 successMessageT: Un mal di testa in meno. Non posso lamentarmi di questo.
it.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: Non indovinerai mai cosa. Uno dei pezzi grossi della banda locale è andato a prendere quella sanguinosa infezione. Bisogna metterlo giù prima che lo trasmetta agli altri.
it.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: Ho pensato che avresti colto al volo l'occasione di attaccare i capi. Bene.
it.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: Bellissimo. Forse ora smetteranno di sanguinare dappertutto.
it.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: Questi stronzi infetti sono una vera spina nel fianco! I miei ragazzi hanno già consumato le scorte mediche necessarie per un mese. Dobbiamo farne entrare di più, altrimenti non avremo alcuna possibilità di tenere sotto controllo questa situazione.
it.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: Quindi non aiuteresti i miei ragazzi? Se lo ricorderanno.
it.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: Beh, almeno ora hanno qualcosa con cui sparare. Quello è un inizio.
it.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: Ogni giorno è un altro dannato pasticcio! Portare dentro le armi non è più così facile come una volta. Tutti temono di contrarre l'infezione da soli. Cosa dovrebbero fare i miei ragazzi senza armi, uccidere a calci gli zombi? Prendimi delle armi e farò in modo che vadano alle persone giuste.
it.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: Hai trovato un altro accordo, vero? Sì, ci ho pensato.
it.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: Ecco, questa sì che è roba. Spero che i miei ragazzi non cadano più come mosche.
it.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: Al giorno d'oggi non si può fare molto senza il vaccino del terapeuta. Sei bravo a parlare con la gente, quindi vai a scambiare due parole con lei. Riporta indietro il più possibile. Ci sistemerò i miei ragazzi.
it.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: Pensavo fossimo tutti dalla stessa parte qui. Immagino di no, eh?
it.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be successMessageT: Questo dovrebbe bastarci per un pò.
it.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: Non può mai esserci troppo materiale per la ricerca. Dirigiti verso le zone rosse ed eliminate quanti più infetti possibile. La mia gente seguirà le tue orme e raccoglierà campioni di tessuto.
it.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be changeQuestMess: Capisco. Dovrò riassegnare la mia gente.
it.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: Recupera campioni di sangue dai corpi delle prime vittime del virus per ulteriori studi. Ricordati che questo può essere fatto solo con strumenti medici.
it.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: Contavo su di te. Ora dovrò trovare qualcun altro per il lavoro.
it.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: Ho di nuovo bisogno di campioni di tessuto fresco dagli infetti. Hai fatto un ottimo lavoro negoziando con altre PMC, quindi mi rivolgo a te. Prima li consegnerai, più saranno utili per la mia ricerca.
it.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: Un peccato. Dovrò trovare un altro modo per ottenere i campioni.

kr.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: 이거 참 실망인데. 됐다, 다른 사람 알아보지, 뭐.
kr.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: 도움을 받을수만 있다면 누구라도 괜찮을 지경이야. 총 들고, 잘 차려입고 나가서 이 거지같은 것들은 싹 정리해버려. 이것들이 너무 활개를 치고 다니니까 발에 자꾸 이놈들 내장들이 밟히잖아.
kr.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 changeQuestMess: 뭐, 해보지도 않고 못하겠다고? 게으름 피우고 있는거지?
kr.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f successMessageT: 좋아요, 이제 최신 정보가 손에 들어왔네요.
kr.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: 전염병이 창궐한 곳에서 최신 정보가 필요해요. 가서 상황을 보고, 살아서 돌아오세요.
kr.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: 실망스럽네요. 이런 정보들은 특히 지금같은 시기에는 중요한데 말이죠.
kr.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: 너도 못 믿을걸, 이거. 지역 대빵 중 한 명이 전염병에 감염된거 같아. 다른 놈들한테 옮기기 전에 밟아줄 놈이 필요해.
kr.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: 대빵이라는 말에 개처럼 달려들줄 알았는데. 그래, 뭐.
kr.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: 좋구만! 이제 사방에 피를 토하고 다니진 않겠지.
kr.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: 이 감염자 씹새끼들이 적당히 거슬려야지! 우리 애들이 이미 한달치 의약품을 모조리 다 써버렸어. 더 못 구해오면 통제는 꿈 깨야할껄.
kr.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: 그래서 우리 애들을 안 도와주시겠다? 그래, 우리 애들이 기억할 거야.
kr.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: 그래, 이제 적어도 뭔가 쏴재낄 건 있네. 시작이 반이지.
kr.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: 매일매일 이 피비린내나는 꼬라지 때문에 아주 개판이야! 총 구하는게 예전만큼 쉽지도 않아. 모두 감염될까봐 벌벌 떨고 있지. 우리 애들한테 들려줄 총도 없으면 뭘 시키는데, 좀비들한테 날라차기라도 하라고 시킬까? 총 좀 구해다줘. 그럼 내가 필요한 사람들한테 전달할거니까.
kr.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: 다른 괜찮은 건수라도 찾은 모양이지? 그럴줄 알았다.
kr.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: 그래, 이래야지. 적어도 우리 애들이 이제는 파리 목숨은 아니였으면 좋겠는데.
kr.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: 테라피스트의 백신이 없으면 뭣도 못할 지경이야. 넌 사람들을 빙빙 꼬시는데 익숙하니까, 가서 그년이랑 이야기나 좀 해봐. 최대한 많이 가져오면, 내가 우리 애들한테 알아서 나눠줄테니까.
kr.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: 우린 같은 편인줄 알았는데, 아니였구만, 응?
kr.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: 연구 물자를 축적하는데 있어 지나침은 있을 수 없지요. 위험 구역으로 들어가 감염자들을 최대한 사살해주세요. 그럼 저희 사람들이 젊은이의 경로를 따라가서 생체 조직을 확보할거에요.
kr.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: 최초 감염자들의 시체에서 혈액 샘플을 채취해서 가져다주세요. 의료 도구를 사용해야만 채취할 수 있는 점 명심하세요.
kr.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: 젊은이만 믿고 있었다고요. 이제 다른 사람을 찾아봐야겠어요.
kr.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: 감염자로부터 갓 얻은 생체 표본 조직이 또다시 필요해요. 다른 PMC와 협업하는데 능하신것 같으니, 당신을 믿어보려 해요. 빨리 가져올수록 제 연구에 큰 도움이 될꺼에요.
kr.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: 아쉽군요. 표본들을 얻을 다른 방법을 찾아야겠어요.

pl.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f description 583: You alright mate? My lads need a few supplies, got a list here. Bring whatever you can get your hands on, the lot of it's useful these days.
pl.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: Bit of a letdown, that. Never mind, I'll find someone else.
pl.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: Could do with all the help we can get right now. Grab a gun, get yourself dressed up nice, and go sort out anything that looks dodgy. These things have been getting far too lively, coughing their guts up on every street corner.
pl.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 changeQuestMess: What, can't be bothered anymore? Getting a bit lazy, are we?
pl.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f successMessageT: Excellent. We now have up-to-date information.
pl.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: I need fresh information from the outbreak zone. Get there, assess the situation, and make it back alive.
pl.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: I am disappointed. This information is particularly important right now.
pl.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 successMessageT: One less headache. Can't complain about that.
pl.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: You'll never guess what. One of the local gang's big shots has gone and caught that bloody infection. Need him put down before he passes it on to the rest.
pl.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: Thought you'd jump at the chance to have a go at the bosses. Fine.
pl.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: Lovely. Maybe now they'll stop bleeding all over the place.
pl.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: These infected cunts are a right pain in the arse! My lads have gone through a month's worth of medical supplies already. Need to get more in, or we won't stand a chance of keeping this lot under control.
pl.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: So you wouldn't help my lads, then? They'll remember that.
pl.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: Well, at least they've got something to shoot with now. That's a start.
pl.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: Every day's another bloody mess! Getting guns in ain't as easy as it used to be. Everyone's worried they'll catch the infection themselves. What are my lads meant to do without guns, dropkick the zombies to death? Get me some weapons and I'll see they go to the right people.
pl.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: Found yourself another deal, have you? Yeah, thought as much.
pl.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: Now that's the stuff. Hopefully my lads won't be dropping like flies anymore.
pl.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: Can't do much without Therapist's vaccine these days. You're good at talking people round, so go have a word with her. Bring back as much as you can get your hands on. I'll sort my lads out with it.
pl.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: Thought we were all on the same side here. Guess not, eh?
pl.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be successMessageT: This should be enough to last us for a while.
pl.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: There can never be too much material for research. Head into the red zones and eliminate as many infected as you can. My people will follow in your footsteps and collect tissue samples.
pl.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be changeQuestMess: I see. I'll have to reassign my people.
pl.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: Retrieve blood samples from the bodies of the virus's first victims for further study. Remember, this can only be done with medical tools.
pl.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: I was counting on you. Now I'll have to find someone else for the job.
pl.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 successMessageT: Good. I'll have them processed right away.
pl.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: I need fresh tissue samples from the infected again. You've been doing an excellent job negotiating with other PMCs, so I'm turning to you. The sooner you deliver them, the more useful they'll be for my research.
pl.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: A pity. I'll have to find another way to obtain the samples.

po.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f successMessageT: Bom garoto. Aqui está a sua parte.
po.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f description 583: Tudo certo, parceiro? Meus rapazes precisam de alguns suprimentos, tenho uma lista aqui. Traga o que conseguir pegar, tudo é útil hoje em dia.
po.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: Que decepção. Deixa pra lá, vou arranjar outro.
po.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 successMessageT: Isso sim é uma limpeza de verdade!
po.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: Eu aceito toda a ajuda possível agora. Pegue uma arma, se arrume direitinho e vá resolver qualquer coisa que pareça suspeita. Essas coisas andam animadas demais, botando os bofes pra fora em cada esquina.
po.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 changeQuestMess: O quê, cansou? Ficando preguiçoso, é?
po.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: Preciso de informações novas da zona do surto. Vá até lá, avalie a situação e volte vivo.
po.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: Estou decepcionada. Essas informações são particularmente importantes neste momento.
po.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 successMessageT: Uma dor de cabeça a menos. Não posso reclamar.
po.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: Você nem imagina. Um dos figurões da gangue local foi lá e pegou essa maldita infecção. Preciso que ele seja abatido antes que passe pro resto.
po.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: Achei que você ia pular de alegria na chance de encarar os chefões. Beleza.
po.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: Ótimo. Talvez agora parem de sangrar por todo lado.
po.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: Esses infectados filhos da puta são um pé no saco! Meus rapazes já gastaram o equivalente a um mês de suprimentos médicos. Preciso arranjar mais, senão não tem chance de manter essa turma sob controle.
po.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: Então você não ia ajudar meus rapazes, é? Eles vão se lembrar disso.
po.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: Bom, pelo menos agora eles têm com o que atirar. É um começo.
po.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: Todo dia é mais uma bagunça do caralho! Conseguir armas não é tão fácil quanto antes. Todo mundo tem medo de pegar a infecção. O que meus rapazes vão fazer sem armas, matar zumbi a voadora? Me consiga algumas armas e eu garanto que vão pras mãos certas.
po.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: Arranjou outro negócio, foi? É, imaginei.
po.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: Isso sim é coisa boa. Com sorte meus rapazes não vão mais cair feito moscas.
po.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: Hoje em dia não dá pra fazer muita coisa sem a vacina da Therapist. Você é bom de lábia, então vá trocar uma ideia com ela. Traga o máximo que conseguir. Eu cuido de abastecer meus rapazes.
po.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: Achei que estávamos todos do mesmo lado aqui. Pelo visto não, hein?
po.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be successMessageT: Isso deve bastar por um bom tempo.
po.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: Nunca há material demais para pesquisa. Entre nas zonas vermelhas e elimine o maior número possível de infectados. Meu pessoal seguirá seus passos e coletará amostras de tecido.
po.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be changeQuestMess: Entendo. Terei que realocar meu pessoal.
po.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: Recupere amostras de sangue dos corpos das primeiras vítimas do vírus para estudo adicional. Lembre-se: isso só pode ser feito com ferramentas médicas.
po.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: Eu contava com você. Agora terei que encontrar outra pessoa para o serviço.
po.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: Preciso de novas amostras de tecido dos infectados novamente. Você tem feito um excelente trabalho negociando com outros PMCs, então recorro a você. Quanto antes as entregar, mais úteis serão para minha pesquisa.
po.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: Uma pena. Terei que encontrar outra maneira de obter as amostras.

ru.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f description 583: Здаров. Моим пацанам нужны припасы всякие, на список. Приноси сразу, как найдёшь. Ща любая мелочь пригодится.
ru.6abb9e0496c356eaac01c10f changeQuestMess: Нихера ты кидала. Но ладно, найду кого-нибудь ещё.
ru.6ad741d45b05fde5460c5793 description 583: Сейчас очень нужна любая помощь. Хватай пушку, надевай парадные штаны и иди месить всех, кто выглядит подозрительно. А то они что-то слишком активные стали, кашляют мне на каждом углу.
ru.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f successMessageT: Отлично. Теперь у нас есть актуальные данные.
ru.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f description 54c: Мне нужны свежие сведения из очага заражения. Доберитесь туда, оцените обстановку и вернитесь живым.
ru.6ad7444a476271984c00e21f changeQuestMess: Очень жаль. Такая информация сейчас особенно важна.
ru.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 description 583: Ты не поверишь, кое-кто из местных авторитетов заразу эту ебучую подхватил. Надо завалить его, пока остальных не перезаражал.
ru.6adeadedc8ab7d23b00981b5 changeQuestMess: Я думал, тебе за радость помесить боссов.
ru.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 successMessageT: Отлично, теперь хоть кровью всё заливать перестанут.
ru.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 description 583: С этими ублюдками заражёнными одни проблемы! Пацаны мои месячный запас медицины истратили. Надо ещё, иначе не сможем сдерживать заразу.
ru.6adeae4d4285d31e390b6326 changeQuestMess: Пацанам помогать отказался? Они не простят.
ru.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 successMessageT: Стрелять теперь есть чем, уже огромный плюс.
ru.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 description 583: Что ни день, то пиздец! Пушки перестали так легко к нам поставлять. Ссыкуют, что тоже заразятся. А пацанам моим без оружия чё делать, ногами зомбей пинать? Достань пушки, я передам кому надо.
ru.6adeae5016c962099903ad10 changeQuestMess: С кем-то другим уже договорился? По роже вижу, что да.
ru.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 successMessageT: Ух, хороша. Теперь хоть пацаны помирать будут реже.
ru.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 description 583: Без вакцины от Терапевта и жизнь не та. Язык у тебя хорошо подвешен, поторгуйся там. Притащи сколько найдёшь вакцины, буду своим пацанам раздавать.
ru.6adeaf97300fa727b808c793 changeQuestMess: Мне казалось, что мы тут все заодно.
ru.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be successMessageT: Этого должно хватить хотя бы на некоторое время.
ru.6adeb28b3fea8e5d570184be description 54c: Материалов для исследований много не бывает. Отправляйтесь в красные зоны и уничтожьте так много заражённых, как сможете. Мои люди пройдут за вами следом и соберут образцы тканей.
ru.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 description 54c: Добудьте для меня образцы крови с трупов первых жертв вируса для дополнительного изучения. Не забудьте, что сделать это можно только с использованием мед инструментов.
ru.6adeb41c402c23693c08e641 changeQuestMess: Я рассчитывала на вас. Теперь придётся искать другого исполнителя.
ru.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 successMessageT: Хорошо. Я сразу передам их в работу.
ru.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 description 54c: Мне снова нужны свежие образцы тканей заражённых. У вас отлично получается торговаться с другими ЧВК, так что обращаюсь именно к вам. Чем быстрее доставите, тем полезнее они будут для исследований.
ru.6adeb514402c23693c08e645 changeQuestMess: Жаль. Значит, придётся искать материал другим способом.
